architectural_decisions.rationale: The communication between both is performed through the internet using the REST API model and the HTTP communication protocol.
This separation allows to add security to the system as the only public access is to the business service, which only contains the minimum information to understand the user's requests.
These requests are processed and sent through an internal connection to the functional service, which is the one that contains the sensitive information of the system.
For better response speed of the system, there is a user cache system stored in Amazon DynamoDB, to which the business service has access.
The data layer is divided into various AWS services that allow improving the performance and scalability of the system.
This pattern is found in the Flux architecture, since the store notifies the views when its state changes.
It is used to create reusable and dynamic components.
It has been used to create the REST API and without its use a REST API could not be created so securely and complexly but at the same time easy to work with.
It has been decided to use NestJS instead of popular alternatives like Express for its opinionated structure that allows creating complex REST APIs.
It has been used to create database entities and to perform database queries.
It has been decided to use TypeORM instead of accessing directly via SQL for its ease of use and its integration with NestJS.
It has been used to deploy the web application and the REST API.
It has been decided to use AWS instead of other alternatives like Google Cloud or Microsoft Azure for its popularity and its low cost.
